messages:
maya.patel: Quick heads-up — we discovered a rare tokenization edge-case hitting a tiny subset of requests in prod (long emoji sequences). Need a micro-patch (2.0.5) with a minimal diff to normalize tokens. Targeting an expedited cutoff today 16:00 UTC. Who can own the branch + smoke?

jason.wu: I can take the branch work. Will do a focused unit + smoke run.

anika.singh: Thanks Jason. Can you also add a one-line changelog entry and a short test that reproduces the edge-case? Keeps regressions obvious in CI.

jason.wu: Yep — adding changelog under docs/changelog/2.0.5.md and a small reproducer in tests/tokenizer/test_emoji_seq.py

ryan.gomez: Do we want a canary rollout first or straight to all hosts? Given scope = tokenizer normalization seems low-risk but touches shared cache. I'd prefer a 10% canary for 30m.

maya.patel: 10% canary SGTM. Also add a safety toggle to the config so we can force-disable if anything weird shows up.

ops-sre: Reminder: cutoff at 16:00 UTC means merges must be final by 15:15 to allow CI and canary bake. Keep PRs small.

jason.wu: On it. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4210 (WIP) — patch does: normalizes ZWJ sequences, adds test, changelog.

deploy-bot: build started for PR #4210 — job 7892 queued

deploy-bot: build passed for PR #4210 — job 7892 (unit+lint) :white_check_mark:

anika.singh: tiny nit: changelog entry please follow template: one-line summary + migration note if any. No migration required here, just state impact.

jason.wu: updated changelog. Migration: none.

ryan.gomez: For canary rollout use rollout policy "gradual-10-30m" in release config. I'll create the release once PR merges. Also add monitoring alert for tokenization-error-rate spike so we can auto-revert.

maya.patel: Good call — Ryan, can you also add an automated smoke that hits the reproducer against the canary pool?

ryan.gomez: Yep — will add a lightweight check.

ops-sre: Rollback plan: tag 2.0.4-rollback ready and cherry-pick revert commit if needed. Keep rollback window 60m after canary completes.

jason.wu: Merged and labeled. CI green. Please start canary when ready.

deploy-bot: release 2.0.5-canary started — 10% traffic to pool-canary-5

anika.singh: running quick manual smoke now against canary URL — no errors so far.

maya.patel: Thanks team. If canary is clean at 16:45 UTC, we'll promote to full roll. If anything odd, revert and open a postmortem. :thumbsup:

ops-sre: logging timeline and tags for audit. I'll watch the canary metrics.

jason.wu: If anyone needs the reproducer:```python
# repro for emoji seq tokenizer
from tokenizer import Tokenizer
text = "👩‍👩‍👧‍👦" * 10
print(Tokenizer().tokens(text))
```

maya.patel: Awesome — keeping this thread for the final postmortem notes. Thanks all.
